provenance.case: an approval prompt for a shell command
provenance.capture: the frame the dormant register row had been waiting for. Codex approves inside its sandbox without asking, so parking one with `-a untrusted` and a shell command is what produced the prompt - the same trick as Claude's --permission-mode manual. The screen reads "$ ping -n 3 127.0.0.1" over three options and the footer "Press enter to confirm or esc to cancel". Sanitized per V1 recipe; ANSI left intact
provenance.identical: not present in the V1 or V2 corpus; V1 refused to guess a Codex wording
